description: Your company's audited traction reports: status, summary, the months and customers covered; for one report, its share links (who each is for, state, expiry, email allowlist, views) and who opened it, from the view log. A link's address is shown once when it is made and never stored, so it cannot be read back. Needs sign-in to Attify; reads only.
name: list_traction_reports
title: Traction reports and share links
